summary: Accepted after an independent source and structural review of all 41 sealed operations in all seven initial-audit groups. The candidate removes invented personal chronology from bare genealogies, office labels, an undated episode, literary allusions, cross-person reign envelopes, an undated succession, retrospective memorial wording, and retrospective edict examples. It preserves the attested non-date facts, replaces unsupported chronology with explicit research holds where appropriate, and does not assert any new life date.

reviewedChanges.reason: This is an undated genealogy only. Removing the AD 830–873 intervals and before-874 hints while retaining the relationship as an unresolved source attestation is source-faithful.
The two units identify offices and kinship but contain no regnal, calendar, or event date. Removing copied AD 860–895 and AD 870–895 contexts and hints, without changing the offices, is correct.

The unit establishes death and succession but gives no year. Replacing the Tang-wide AD 881–907 envelope with unresolved source attestations avoids fabricating a personal chronology.

They support the surviving office, overthrow, and assessment facts but not AD 926–933, AD 929, or AD 923–933 personal life or death chronology; the candidate removes only the unsupported date containers and paired hints.
